changelog.zh:
- 新增：外部播放器（T1）——取流仍由本软件负责（UA/防盗链/302），视频交给 PotPlayer / mpv / VLC 播放
- 新增：本地回环代理（127.0.0.1 随机端口 + 一次性 token），自动重写 HLS 清单的分片/密钥/子清单地址
- 新增：代理内上游 403/404/410 自动重新解析真实地址，防盗链过期不中断
- 新增：设置 → 播放 → 外部播放器（内置 / mpv / PotPlayer / VLC / 自定义路径），自动探测注册表安装位置
- 优化：外挂播放时自动停用内置解码，关闭外部播放器后自动恢复界面
- 说明：外挂播放器可自行开启 display-resample / 插帧（如 SVP、vs-rife），不再受 Flutter 纹理渲染链路限制
changelog.en:
- New: external player mode (T1) — this app keeps handling streaming (UA / anti-leech / 302), video is decoded by PotPlayer / mpv / VLC
- New: loopback proxy (127.0.0.1, random port, one-time token) that rewrites HLS playlists (segments / keys / variant playlists)
- New: automatic upstream re-resolution on 403/404/410 inside the proxy, so expiring anti-leech tokens do not kill playback
- New: Settings → Playback → External Player (built-in / mpv / PotPlayer / VLC / custom path) with registry auto-detection
- Improvement: built-in decoding is stopped while the external player is active, and the UI restores when it closes
- Note: with an external player you can enable display-resample or frame interpolation (SVP, vs-rife) without the Flutter texture pipeline
